requirements.name: The right half shows whatever I ask for, one click away
requirements.why: His change to R3: "add tabs ... so that you can switch between what information you are showing on the right hand side. One can be like q, qd, qdd, qddd, q/qd/qdd, TCP ... etc. ... we get the option to basically like show what ever particualy information we want there."
requirements.passCondition: Tabs on the right half cover q, qd, qdd, qddd, q/qd/qdd and TCP (or a stated equivalent), each readable on its own, one click apart, the left half unchanged when switching.

anchors.1: One fixed set of plots, or the information he named is missing.
anchors.3: His tabs are there but crowded, mislabelled or need scrolling to read.
anchors.5: His six (plus useful extras) one click apart, each tab readable at a glance, nothing he named missing.

requirements.name: The arm on the left tells the story on its own
requirements.why: "we are always showing the 3d robot"; R3 won the first round because the arm is the hero.
requirements.passCondition: From the left half alone you can tell where the motion goes, where it is now, and one more thing that matters (where it starts/ends, how hard it works, or how far it is off).

anchors.1: An arm with no context: no path, no start/end, nothing beyond the pose.
anchors.3: Path and current pose, but nothing about limits, error or key moments.
anchors.5: Path, now, start/end and one load-bearing signal (limits, error, events) readable without the plots.

requirements.name: A tracking run (target vs solution) reads at a glance
requirements.why: The viewer is the Trajectory Tracking Agent's Open in Rerun: every row there is a target and a solution.
requirements.passCondition: On the agent's run, you can see where and how much the solution is off the target, in the arm and in the plots, with the agent's own error number.

anchors.1: Only one of the two is shown; no error anywhere.
anchors.3: Both are in the plots, or the error is shown, but not where along the motion it happens.
anchors.5: Target and solution together, the error over time with the agent's number, and the arm shows where it was off.

requirements.name: Joint values legible against limits, in degrees
requirements.why: Zach's standing rule (degrees) and the first round's criterion; limits are what a reviewer checks.
requirements.passCondition: Every series is named, in degrees, its limit visible, its peak or % of limit stated.

anchors.3: Degrees and names, limits only on some tabs.
anchors.5: Degrees, every series named, limits drawn and the closest approach stated on every joint tab.

requirements.name: Scrubbing keeps the two halves in step and finds the moments
requirements.why: Playing the motion back is the point of Rerun; a long run needs its moments findable.
requirements.passCondition: The playhead moves the arm and every plot's cursor together; the interesting moments (start, end, peak, worst) can be found without hunting.

anchors.1: Arm and plots out of step, or the time panel hidden.
anchors.3: In step, but finding a moment means scrubbing by eye.
anchors.5: In step, and the key moments are marked or one click away.

requirements.name: Stays the one stock viewer, additive
requirements.why: "one stock viewer per data type, grown, never a new one"; the agent's site already calls robot= and must keep working.
requirements.passCondition: One function from a JointTrajectory + URDF (+ an optional target) to a recording, any arm, and today's robot= call keeps its output.

anchors.1: Hard-wired to the UR5e or this run, or breaks today's robot= call.
anchors.3: General, but needs per-arm tuning or a second function.
anchors.5: Any JointTrajectory + URDF, an optional target argument, today's call unchanged.

hardGates.name: His frame: the 3D URDF arm on the left half, tabs on the right half, always
hardGates.why: "split the page in half. we are always showing the 3d robot".

hardGates.name: Opens with no errors in the real Rerun 0.40 web viewer
hardGates.why: film.cjs: no ERROR / panic lines (the viewer's own 403 on load is not the recording's).

hardGates.name: Angles in degrees
hardGates.why: Zach's standing rule for anything he reads.

hardGates.name: Additive: robot_msgs is not edited, and today's robot= recording is unchanged
